parties: <cite index="35-1">India Resurgence Fund (backed by Piramal Finance and Bain Capital)</cite> acquired <cite index="1-2">a majority stake in Fine Edge Engineering Private Limited, which operates the iron casting and machining business of Ashok Iron Works and its group companies</cite>
headline: India Resurgence Fund (IndiaRF) acquired Fine Edge Engineering Private Limited in a transaction valued at around ₹2,000 crore, establishing control over Ashok Iron Works' foundry and precision machining business.
sum: <cite index="1-2">India Resurgence Fund has acquired a majority stake in Fine Edge Engineering Private Limited, which operates the iron casting and machining business of Ashok Iron Works</cite>. <cite index="2-7">IndiaRF intends to support the business through investments in capacity expansion, research and development, new product development and operational improvements</cite>.
implication: PE acquisition of India's largest precision machined-castings manufacturer signals institutional consolidation in high-horsepower engine-block supply for global data-centre infrastructure, marking a rare control entry into family-held foundry engineering with focus on automation and scale.
detail: <cite index="1-3,1-4">Founded in 1974, Ashok Iron Works is based in Belagavi, Karnataka, and manufactures machined iron castings used in industrial engines, agricultural equipment, and automobiles, operating four foundries with a combined capacity of 1,44,000 metric tonnes per annum (MTPA) and seven machine shops that can produce around 600,000 parts annually</cite>. <cite index="2-8">Investec acted as the exclusive sell-side adviser to the Ashok Iron Works Group and its shareholders for the transaction</cite>. <cite index="4-8">The transaction reinforces strong investor interest in India's precision machined castings sector, supported by growing demand for high-horsepower engine applications, particularly from the global data centre build-out</cite>.
